body: A deep learning library for audio generation and processing that includes MusicGen and the EnCodec audio codec.
plain_description: **Create high-quality music and sound from text prompts.** Control music generation with text or melodies. Explore audio generation and compression models for research and training.
technical_description: AudioCraft is a PyTorch library for audio-generation research, with inference and training code for AudioGen and MusicGen. It also includes EnCodec, Multi Band Diffusion, MAGNeT, AudioSeal, MusicGen Style, and JASCO. The README documents installation, model-specific workflows, training pipelines, and API documentation.
title: AudioCraft
